---
title: "Theory"
---

Background on the ideas behind `masreml` and `masbayes` — why breeding
moved from measuring traits to reading genomes, and why the markers we
read do not have to be single letters. These pages explain
the reasoning that the [tasks](../tasks/index.qmd) then put to work on
real data.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [**Genomic Selection**](genomic-selection.qmd) | Why selective breeding hits a wall on late, destructive, or sex-limited traits, and how markers, LD, and GEBVs get around it |
| [**From Bi-allelic to Multi-allelic Markers**](multiallelic-markers.qmd) | Why reading several nearby SNPs as one microhaplotype carries more information than reading them one at a time |

Read them in order if you are new to genomic prediction — the second
page assumes the marker/QTL picture built in the first.
